education:
I started out at St Joseph’s Secondary School in Derry, where I developed a real interest in tech through subjects like I.T., Maths, and Science. Those early experiences gave me a solid foundation and set me on the path toward a career in computing.

From there, I began studying Computer Science remotely with the University of Hertfordshire, working toward a CertHE. I consistently achieved first-class results and really built up my confidence with core concepts like programming, systems design, and problem-solving. The course was unfortunately cut short when HLA Management at Deloitte moved us to a different provider, but it gave me a strong technical base to build on.

I then completed a BSc in Computing Systems at the University of Ulster, graduating with a 2:1. Over four years, I developed proficiency in areas such as software engineering, database systems, cloud infrastructure, and cybersecurity. The degree combined hands-on projects with theoretical modules, equipping me with the tools and mindset to tackle complex technical challenges. I graduated confident in both my practical skills and my ability to learn and adapt in a fast-evolving field.
